Follow-up work by Tang and colleagues (134) showed that 10 g of EAAs provided by whey hydrolysate (a fast-acting protein ) promoted markedly greater increases in mixed muscle protein synthesis after both rest and exercise compared to soy protein isolate and casein ( slow-acting proteins ). It is speculated that the fast-digesting nature of whey is responsible for this enhanced anabolic response.
